question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. Rearrange the remaining four sentences (P, Q, R, S) to form a coherent paragraph. || S1: The sudden spike in global oil prices has triggered a wave of inflation. || P: Consequently, the central bank had to intervene to stabilize the currency. || Q: This inflation is not just limited to fuel but has cascaded to essential commodities. || R: Ordinary citizens are finding it increasingly difficult to manage their household budgets. || S: Furthermore, transport costs have doubled, directly affecting the prices of fresh produce. || S6: If this macroeconomic instability continues, the overall economic growth for the fiscal year will stall. || Question: What is the correct sequence?
explanation: S1 mein 'inflation' ki baat hui hai. Q mein 'This inflation' bol kar S1 se direct link banaya gaya hai. Q ke baad S aayega kyunki usme transport cost badhne ka asar fresh produce par bataya hai. Essential commodities mehangi hone ka effect household budgets (R) par padta hai. Is crisis ki wajah se central bank intervene karta hai (P). P ka connection seedha S6 se hai kyunki bank ke action ke baad hi macroeconomic instability ki aage ki condition batayi gayi hai.
trick: S1 ke end ka idea 'inflation' hai. Q mein 'This inflation' likha hai, toh pehla sentence Q hoga. Options check karo aur baki eliminate karo.
tip: Pronoun 'This' ko S1 ke noun se hamesha link karo.

question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. explanation: S1 mein Black holes introduce hue hain. P unki main property 'gravitational pull' batata hai ('Their' refers to Black holes). Q mein 'This includes light' P ki baat ko complete karta hai. Light escape nahi hoti, isliye (therefore) astronomers nearby stars ko observe karte hain (R). S mein explain kiya hai ki stars ko observe karne par kya hota hai (X-rays emit hoti hain). S6 directly S se link karta hai 'These X-ray emissions' bol kar.
trick: S6 mein 'These X-ray emissions' likha hai. P, Q, R, S mein dekho X-ray ki baat kahan hui hai. S mein X-ray hai, toh S aakhri hona chahiye. Option PQRS choose karo.
tip: S6 ke starting words se S4 (aakhri sentence) ka link dhoondo.

question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. S6 uske baad conclude karta hai ki upgrades hone ke baad hi ('Only then') asli impact dikhega.
trick: R mein 'tests' ki baat hai aur S mein 'these tests' hai. Toh R aur S hamesha saath aayenge (RS pair). S6 mein 'Only then' hai, jo Q ke condition ko pura karne ke baad ka result hai.
tip: Sequence banate waqt logic flow aur conditional words check karo.

question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. tip: Transition phrases (On one hand...) strong hints dete hain.

question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. Rearrange the remaining four sentences (P, Q, R, S) to form a coherent paragraph. || S1: Quantum computers operate on principles completely different from classical computers. || P: This allows them to process vast amounts of data at unprecedented speeds. || Q: Instead of using bits that are either zero or one, they use qubits. || R: Such computational power could easily break current cryptographic security systems. || S: Qubits can exist in a state of superposition, representing both zero and one simultaneously. || S6: Therefore, researchers are racing to develop quantum-resistant encryption methods. || Question: What is the correct sequence?
explanation: S1 kehta hai ki principles different hain. Q batata hai difference kya hai (bits ki jagah qubits). S qubits ko explain karta hai (superposition). P batata hai ki is superposition ('This') ki wajah se speed badh jati hai. R batata hai ki is computational power ki wajah se security system toot sakte hain. S6 result batata hai ki isliye naye encryption ban rahe hain.
trick: Q mein 'qubits' introduce hue hain, aur S mein unko define kiya gaya hai. Isliye Q ke baad S aayega. 'Such computational power' R mein P ke 'unprecedented speeds' ko point karta hai.
tip: Chronology follow karo: Introduce -> Define -> Application.

question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. tip: Economy crises ki chain: Panic (R) -> Bank fail (S) -> Business drop (P) -> Job loss (Q).

question: Direction: In the following question, the first (S1) and the last (S6) sentences of a passage are fixed. explanation: S1 vaccine ka immune system train karne ka kam batata hai. Q samjhata hai ki woh yeh training kaise ('They achieve this') karte hain (weakened virus dalkar). R body ka immediate reaction batata hai (detect and produce antibodies). P training process ke khatam hone ('Once cellular memory is established') ke baad ki situation batata hai. trick: Q mein 'weakened... version' of virus aata hai. R us virus ko 'this harmless foreign invader' keh kar body ka defense dikhata hai. P us defense process ka completion ('memory established') batata hai. Q->R->P logical sequence hai.
tip: Biological Mechanism: Enter Invader (Q) -> System Reacts (R) -> Memory Creates (P) -> Future Protect (S).
